name: instagram-mcp-ai
description: MCP server for the Instagram Platform (Meta Graph API) — professional-account tools.
long_description: instagram-mcp-ai exposes Instagram professional-account (Business/Creator) operations — content publishing, media management, comment moderation, and insights — as safe, well-annotated Model Context Protocol tools. It talks only to official Meta Graph API endpoints (graph.instagram.com, graph.facebook.com), keeps credentials in the OS keychain via Claude Desktop's user configuration, and defaults writes to a preview (plan-and-apply) mode so the model never mutates your account without explicit consent.

tools.name: instagram_get_account
tools.description: Fetch the profile of the operated Instagram professional account: username, display name, biography, website, profile-picture URL, and follower / following / media counts.

tools.name: instagram_list_linked_accounts
tools.description: Enumerate the Facebook Pages this token can act on and the Instagram business account linked to each (GET /me/accounts).

tools.name: instagram_token_status
tools.description: Report the active credential: auth path (A = ig-login / B = fb-login), whether a token is configured, the resolved account ID, and — on Path B, via debug_token — validity, granted scopes, absolute expiry and days-left (with a refresh warning as the threshold nears).

tools.name: instagram_list_media
tools.description: List the operated account's own media (feed posts, reels, albums), newest first, cursor-paginated.

tools.name: instagram_list_stories
tools.description: List the operated account's live stories — only those still inside Instagram's 24-hour window, newest first, cursor-paginated.

tools.name: instagram_get_media
tools.description: Fetch a single media object by id, including its carousel children (album items) under `children`.

tools.name: instagram_get_account_insights
tools.description: Account-level insights for the operated Instagram professional account (GET /{ig-id}/insights).

tools.name: instagram_get_media_insights
tools.description: Insights for a single media object (GET /{media-id}/insights).

tools.name: instagram_get_audience_demographics
tools.description: Follower / engaged-audience demographics for the operated account (GET /{ig-id}/insights with metric_type=total_value).

tools.name: instagram_get_online_followers
tools.description: Hourly distribution of when the account's followers are online (GET /{ig-id}/insights?metric=online_followers&period=lifetime).

tools.name: instagram_create_media_container
tools.description: Phase 1 of publishing: create a media container that Instagram ingests from a public HTTPS URL.

tools.name: instagram_get_container_status
tools.description: Read a media container's processing state: status_code is IN_PROGRESS, FINISHED, ERROR, EXPIRED, or PUBLISHED.

tools.name: instagram_publish_media
tools.description: Phase 2 of publishing: publish a media container that has finished processing, returning the new media id.

tools.name: instagram_get_publishing_limit
tools.description: Report the account's content-publishing usage against its rolling-window quota.

tools.name: instagram_post_image
tools.description: Publish a single feed image, or a 2–10 image carousel, in one call: create the container(s), wait for processing, then publish.

tools.name: instagram_post_reel
tools.description: Publish a reel in one call: create the REELS container, wait for processing (reels can take a while), then publish.

tools.name: instagram_post_story
tools.description: Publish a photo or video story in one call: create the STORIES container, wait for processing, then publish.

tools.name: instagram_delete_media
tools.description: Permanently delete a published post, reel, story or whole carousel album (DELETE /{ig-media-id}).

tools.name: instagram_list_comments
tools.description: List the top-level comments on a media object, newest first, cursor-paginated, with threaded replies expanded inline under `replies` (repliesTruncated=true marks a thread Instagram cut at its first page of replies; instagram_list_comment_replies reads the rest).

tools.name: instagram_list_comment_replies
tools.description: List the replies to one comment, cursor-paginated, in the order Instagram returns them.

tools.name: instagram_get_comment
tools.description: Fetch a single comment by id, including its moderation state (hidden), parent/media context, and inline replies (repliesTruncated=true when Instagram returned only the first page of them; instagram_list_comment_replies reads the rest).

tools.name: instagram_list_tagged_media
tools.description: List media the operated account has been TAGGED IN (the /tags edge), newest first, cursor-paginated.

tools.name: instagram_get_mentioned_media
tools.description: Fetch a media object whose caption @mentions the operated account, by its media id (GET /{ig-id}?fields=mentioned_media.media_id(<id>){…}).

tools.name: instagram_get_mentioned_comment
tools.description: Fetch a comment that @mentions the operated account, by its comment id (GET /{ig-id}?fields=mentioned_comment.comment_id(<id>){…}), with the id of the media it was made on.

tools.name: instagram_reply_to_comment
tools.description: Post a threaded reply under an existing comment (POST /{comment-id}/replies).

tools.name: instagram_create_comment
tools.description: Post a new top-level comment on a media object (POST /{media-id}/comments).

tools.name: instagram_hide_comment
tools.description: Hide a comment (POST /{comment-id}?hide=true) — reversible moderation, preferred over delete.

tools.name: instagram_unhide_comment
tools.description: Unhide a previously hidden comment (POST /{comment-id}?hide=false).

tools.name: instagram_delete_comment
tools.description: Permanently delete a comment (DELETE /{comment-id}).

tools.name: instagram_set_comments_enabled
tools.description: Toggle whether a media object accepts new comments (POST /{media-id}?comment_enabled=true|false).

tools.name: instagram_search_hashtag
tools.description: Resolve a hashtag name to its Instagram hashtag id(s) via GET /ig_hashtag_search?user_id={ig-id}&q=<hashtag> (the returned id feeds instagram_get_hashtag_media).

tools.name: instagram_get_hashtag_media
tools.description: List PUBLIC media under a hashtag id via GET /{hashtag-id}/top_media or /{hashtag-id}/recent_media (choose via `edge`), which require the operated account's id as user_id.

tools.name: instagram_list_recently_searched_hashtags
tools.description: List the hashtags the operated account searched in the last 7 days via GET /{ig-id}/recently_searched_hashtags — Meta's own record of the 30-unique-hashtags per rolling 7 days budget that instagram_search_hashtag spends.

tools.name: instagram_discover_business
tools.description: Fetch another business/creator's PUBLIC profile and recent media by handle via GET /{ig-id}?fields=business_discovery.username(<handle>){followers_count,media_count,media{...}}.

IG_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Instagram access token
IG_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Long-lived Instagram Login (Path A) access token for your professional account. Obtain it with the Instagram Login flow of your Meta app (the `login` CLI, or the app dashboard) — see docs/mcpb-install.md. For a Facebook Login (Path B) token, set Auth path to "fb-login".

IG_ACCOUNT_ID.title: Instagram account ID
IG_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Instagram professional-account (Business/Creator) ID. Optional with an Instagram-Login token (calls then address `me`); set it with a Facebook-Login (Page / system-user) token, where `me` is not the Instagram account.

IG_APP_ID.title: Meta app ID
IG_APP_ID.description: Your Meta app ID. Optional — needed only for token refresh, debug_token, and discovery (business_discovery / hashtag search on Path B).

IG_APP_SECRET.title: Meta app secret
IG_APP_SECRET.description: Your Meta app secret. Optional — needed only for token exchange/refresh and appsecret_proof (Path B).

IG_AUTH_MODE.title: Auth path
IG_AUTH_MODE.description: Which login the token came from: "ig-login" (Instagram Login, Path A, default) or "fb-login" (Facebook Login, Path B; also needs the app ID and secret). Pinned here because filling both app fields would otherwise make the server infer "fb-login".

IG_WRITE_MODE.title: Write mode
IG_WRITE_MODE.description: Standing consent for write operations: "preview" (plan only, default) or "apply" (execute writes).

IG_TOOL_PACKAGES.title: Tool packages
IG_TOOL_PACKAGES.description: Which tool packages to load: core | reader | publisher | all, or an explicit comma-separated list.
